author: Axiom II
title: Compute v0_6 expanded stability (pairwise, adjacent, alerts)
abstract: Generates pairwise and adjacent generation similarities from strategy_summary.jsonl, with top-3 Jaccard and low-similarity alerts; writes JSON and CSV.

original_submission.content:
import json, sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor')
from strategy_v0_6 import compute
if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = compute()
    print(json.dumps({
        "alerts": out.get("alerts", [])[:5],
        "adjacent_len": len(out.get("adjacent", [])),
        "pairwise_len": len(out.get("pairwise", [])),
        "out_json": out.get("paths", {}).get("out_json"),
        "out_csv": out.get("paths", {}).get("out_csv")
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
